Suwannee — Personnel

Suwannee directory observation: October 21, 2026.

Suwannee: six judge records, two court officers and the clerk. Douglas is included by the county-tag roster without a confirmed routine Suwannee assignment; Jackson is a named county recusal successor. Shared administration contacts and missing personal procedures remain qualified. Court records are not online according to the clerk; the Court Records link provides official access guidance.
